run_libsize_check: run libsize.py on a .so file to display its size and compare against a saved baseline
run_libsize_baseline: run libsize.py to create a new baseline size file for a shared library
run_libsize_compare: run libsize.py to compare the current .so file size against a previously saved size
review_libsize_script: review the libsize.py script that measures shared library file sizes and tracks changes over time
refactor_libsize_script: refactor libsize.py to accept command-line arguments via argparse instead of raw sys.argv
